beats.say: Formula One might get its youngest ever world champion this weekend.
Mercedes driver Kimi Antonelli is twenty, with a mathematical chance to win the title in Austin.
Friday practice at the United States Grand Prix began with Charles Leclerc leading Antonelli.
Yet Antonelli came within inches of first despite a major early setback.
According to Sky Sports, he had a loose seat that needed a ten minute repair.
The Guardian reports he started karting aged five, and now history waits in Texas.
Can Antonelli seal the Formula One championship this weekend?
